svg.title: Bet on Dave: ragdolls on the high wire
svg.desc: Pencil sketch under a circus big top: one ragdoll balances on a sagging high wire with a pole, another hangs on by one hand, and Dave tumbles upside down mid-wipeout while the crowd below waves betting slips and an odds board reads 7:2.
